description:
Role: Informatica ETL Developer
 Duration: 6 months +
 Location: Ontario, CA
 
 
 Job Description: 

 

 Responsibilities: 
 • Understanding Data Sources; Use Data Modeling concepts to design and develop Dimensional Model for a Data Warehouse
 • Design & Development of Data Integration processes using Informatica PowerCenter 9.5.1
 Administer PowerCenter environment to ensure security, auditability, Data Validation, Data Analysis, performance tuning and other required data integration related activities
 • Analysis, design, deployment, coding and testing of Data warehousing using Informatica (ETL) on OLAP and OLTP environment and implementation of Database Management Systems  
 • Database Modeling/Designing using Erwin to design Conceptual/Logical/Physical Modeling, Forward/Reverse engineering and ER Modeling, Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema) and Data Warehousing, OLAP tools.
 • Implementation of Data Warehousing, Data Marts, Star and Snow Flake Schema Modeling,
 Dimensional Modeling on OLTP and OLAP concepts using Ralph Kimball and Bill Inmon methodologies.
 • Designing and developing mappings, mapplets and reusable transformations using Informatica Designer. Proficient in Normalization/Denormalization techniques
 • Support existing data ware house solution while fine tuning the system for optimal performance 
 • Proficient in Agile/scrum project methodology
 

 Required Knowledge and Experience: 
 • Long track record on data warehouse/business intelligence design and build.
 • Minimum of 5-7 years of current, hands on development experience implementing ETL solutions, particularly utilizing Informatica Powercenter ETL platform – Powercenter 9.x or above.  
 • Experience with Oracle Applications E-Business Suite 11.5.10 or R12 as data source or general knowledge of Oracle e-Business data structures highly desirable
 • Strong Database Development Skills (particularly implementing SQL solutions in Oracle 10g/11g Database to build large-scale applications.)  
 • Strong experience in the design and development of mappings, transformations, sessions and workflows
 • Experience with a variety of sources (EBS, XML, Oracle, flat file, excel spreadsheets, transactional (OLTP) sources, etc.). 
 • Experience and advanced knowledge of logical and physical database modeling concepts and techniques 
 • Understand normalized and star-schema (dimensional) physical models and logical modeling concepts. 
 • Extensive programming experience in SQL & PL/SQL, tuning and optimization.
 • Extensive experience determining, developing, testing, and implementing system requirements and specifications
 • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
 • Experience working in Agile development software methodology
 Education:
 BA/BS in Business, Information Systems, Statistics or relevant discipline 
 



 Syed Mohammad Asif
